metadata.scope: Public, patched, disclosed, locally reported, or contest-unverified Ethereum P2P/network security knowledge. EL entries are transferable patterns only.

taxonomy.unchecked_length_or_count: A peer-controlled length, count, list size, subnet index, or range is accepted before checking protocol bounds.
taxonomy.integer_overflow_underflow: Arithmetic on peer-controlled values wraps, underflows, or crosses a sentinel boundary before validation.
taxonomy.unbounded_allocation: Parser, cache, queue, decompressor, or protocol book allocation scales with attacker-controlled input.
taxonomy.unbounded_streams_or_fds: Connection, stream, goroutine, file descriptor, or multiplexer state grows without a tight peer/global bound.
taxonomy.malformed_framing_or_encoding: Malformed SSZ, snappy, protobuf, RLP, topic, or packet framing reaches panic-prone or inconsistent handling paths.
taxonomy.handshake_crypto_validation: Peer identity or transport crypto handshakes accept invalid keys, nonces, signatures, or identity bindings.
taxonomy.discovery_amplification: Discovery handling can amplify packets, fill tables, leak routing state, or preserve unverified endpoints.
taxonomy.gossipsub_scoring_or_punishment_gap: Malformed or abusive gossip is not scored, disconnected, or throttled quickly enough.
taxonomy.dedup_or_replay_gap: Repeated, stale, duplicated, or replayed messages are not collapsed before expensive work or response generation.
taxonomy.timeout_or_slowloris: Slow, partial, or idle handshakes/streams retain resources beyond expected timeout boundaries.
taxonomy.rate_limit_or_quota_accounting: Rate-limit accounting is absent, underspecified, bypassable, or charges the wrong unit of work.
taxonomy.spec_ambiguity: The spec leaves behavior underdefined enough for inconsistent, security-relevant client behavior.

entries.title: Lighthouse discovery crash via many discv5 sessions
entries.impact: A remote network agent could crash Lighthouse discovery nodes by creating many discv5 sessions.
entries.preconditions: Attacker can reach the target discovery UDP endpoint and initiate many discovery sessions.
entries.exploit_shape: Open or trigger large numbers of discv5 sessions until discovery service state is exhausted.
entries.root_cause: Discovery session lifecycle and resource accounting did not bound attacker-created state tightly enough.
entries.fix_shape: Cap discovery session state, apply per-peer/IP admission limits, and expire incomplete sessions promptly.
transfer_candidates: Add a discv5 session-flood test that tracks target memory, session count, and liveness under many incomplete handshakes.

entries.title: Discv5 RLP packet-size DoS and WHOAREYOU amplification
entries.impact: Malformed or undersized discovery packets could crash clients and trigger oversized WHOAREYOU replies.
entries.preconditions: Attacker can send UDP packets to the discovery port.
entries.exploit_shape: Send malformed RLP/discv5 packets that exploit missing packet-size validation and induce amplified responses.
entries.root_cause: The discovery packet parser and response path did not enforce packet-size and encoding checks before replying.
entries.fix_shape: Reject malformed packets before response generation and enforce request/response size invariants.
transfer_candidates: Keep raw discv5 malformed packet and response-amplification probes at packet-size boundaries.

entries.title: Teku gossipsub unchecked length allocation DoS
entries.impact: A malicious gossip message could force a large allocation and prevent Teku from participating in consensus.
entries.preconditions: Attacker is a connected gossip peer or can deliver gossip RPCs to the target.
entries.exploit_shape: Craft a gossipsub message with an attacker-controlled length field that drives buffer allocation.
entries.root_cause: The decode path allocated based on a peer-controlled length before enforcing protocol maximums.
entries.fix_shape: Check declared lengths before allocation and reject messages over topic/protocol limits.
transfer_candidates: Add gossip length-bomb variants with declared decompressed sizes at max, max+1, and very large values.

entries.title: Prysm gossip message-id snappy allocation blowup
entries.impact: A single crafted gossip message could drive multi-gigabyte allocation while computing the gossip message ID.
entries.preconditions: Attacker can publish a crafted gossip message to a topic processed by the target.
entries.exploit_shape: Use a snappy varint header that declares a huge decompressed size during message-id calculation.
entries.root_cause: Message-id computation decompressed or sized snappy data before bounding the declared size.
entries.fix_shape: Bound snappy decode length during message-id calculation and hash invalid snappy under the invalid-snappy domain.
transfer_candidates: Add explicit gossip message-id tests for invalid snappy and declared-size bombs.

entries.title: Lighthouse gossip cache OOM before user validation
entries.impact: Many compressed gossip messages could stay in libp2p cache long enough to cause a large memory spike.
entries.preconditions: Attacker can send large gossip RPC containers to the target.
entries.exploit_shape: Pack many crafted compressed messages into gossip RPCs before validation can reject or evict them.
entries.root_cause: The libp2p message cache retained pre-validation messages without sufficient byte-size bounds.
entries.fix_shape: Bound cache bytes, reject oversized RPC containers early, and avoid retaining invalid messages.
transfer_candidates: Add longer-horizon gossip RPC cache-pressure tests that measure memory and eviction behavior across clients.

entries.title: Teku identify protobuf stream without timeout or size limit
entries.impact: A peer could feed an identify protobuf stream slowly until the JVM process ran out of memory.
entries.preconditions: Attacker can open a libp2p identify stream to the target.
entries.exploit_shape: Send a valid protobuf container prefix with a very large length, then drip-feed bytes to pin memory.
entries.root_cause: The identify handler lacked stream-level timeouts and protobuf size limits.
entries.fix_shape: Apply identify protocol read deadlines, max protobuf lengths, and per-peer stream accounting.
transfer_candidates: Keep libp2p identify large-protobuf and slow-read probes opt-in because they are resource-intensive.

entries.title: Teku mplex unlimited open streams memory pressure
entries.impact: A peer could open very many mplex streams and add multiple gigabytes of memory pressure.
entries.preconditions: Attacker can establish a libp2p connection to the target.
entries.exploit_shape: Send many mplex create frames, with or without full protocol negotiation, to retain stream state.
entries.root_cause: The stream multiplexer and handler path did not enforce a tight stream count/memory budget.
entries.fix_shape: Bound open streams per connection and globally, and close unauthenticated or excess streams promptly.
transfer_candidates: Add raw multiplexer stream-create floods that bypass req/resp request construction.

entries.title: Lodestar Noise nonce handling deviates from libp2p Noise requirements
entries.impact: Improper Noise nonce width and overflow behavior weakened transport handshake invariants.
entries.preconditions: Attacker can perform enough Noise handshakes or traffic to exercise nonce handling boundaries.
entries.exploit_shape: Drive nonce values toward overflow or rely on non-standard 32-bit nonce handling.
entries.root_cause: The implementation used 32-bit nonce handling where the Noise spec requires 64-bit behavior and overflow errors.
entries.fix_shape: Use spec-compliant nonce widths and return hard errors on nonce exhaustion.
transfer_candidates: Add deeper transport crypto conformance checks for key type, static key binding, and nonce-boundary behavior where feasible.

entries.title: Multi-client file descriptor exhaustion
entries.impact: Connected peers could exhaust file descriptors across multiple clients and degrade node availability.
entries.preconditions: Attacker can create many connections or hold connections open to the target.
entries.exploit_shape: Open enough network connections or streams to exceed process or OS file descriptor limits.
entries.root_cause: Connection admission and cleanup did not bound file descriptor consumption under hostile peer behavior.
entries.fix_shape: Enforce per-peer/IP/global connection limits, prune idle peers, and surface fd pressure metrics.
transfer_candidates: Add fd-count and connection-slot telemetry checks during high-connection tests.

entries.title: Lighthouse BlocksByRange crash via overly large count
entries.impact: A malicious BeaconBlocksByRange request with a very large count could crash Lighthouse beacon nodes.
entries.preconditions: Attacker can complete req/resp negotiation and send BlocksByRange requests.
entries.exploit_shape: Send a BlocksByRange request whose count exceeds the protocol maximum or arithmetic-safe range.
entries.root_cause: The range handler accepted an oversized peer-controlled count before safe bounds checks.
entries.fix_shape: Reject count values above MAX_REQUEST_BLOCKS before range math, allocation, or iteration.
transfer_candidates: Keep range-count boundary tests for every new req/resp range protocol, including data columns and payload envelopes.

entries.title: Nimbus libp2p protobuf parsing remote crash
entries.impact: Malformed libp2p protobuf input could remotely crash a Nimbus node.
entries.preconditions: Attacker can reach the affected libp2p protocol path.
entries.exploit_shape: Send malformed protobuf frames that exercise parser error paths in libp2p/Nimbus integration.
entries.root_cause: Malformed protobuf input was not converted into a contained peer error before reaching crash-prone code.
entries.fix_shape: Harden protobuf decode error handling and add malformed identify/protobuf regression tests.
transfer_candidates: Keep malformed libp2p identify/protobuf frame probes in heavy mode.

entries.title: Nimbus missing punishment for malformed data gossipsub
entries.impact: Malformed gossip could avoid expected peer punishment and remain available for repeated validation abuse.
entries.preconditions: Attacker is a gossip peer on data topics.
entries.exploit_shape: Repeatedly publish malformed data gossip and observe whether score, disconnect, or graylist thresholds are reached.
entries.root_cause: Gossipsub validation failure did not feed the expected scoring/punishment path for malformed data.
entries.fix_shape: Map malformed data outcomes to Reject/penalty paths and add per-topic scoring regression coverage.
transfer_candidates: Record score deltas or disconnect evidence after malformed data-column and blob gossip, not only accept/reject outcome.

entries.title: Nimbus malformed attestation remote crash
entries.impact: Malformed attestation gossip could crash a Nimbus node.
entries.preconditions: Attacker can publish malformed attestation gossip to the target.
entries.exploit_shape: Craft attestation payloads that pass enough framing to reach a crash-prone validation path.
entries.root_cause: Malformed attestation validation was not fully contained by decode and validation wrappers.
entries.fix_shape: Convert malformed attestation cases into safe Reject/Ignore outcomes and regression-test semantic malformed bodies.
transfer_candidates: Add signed-body attestation semantic mutants guarded by scoring/DoS run mode.

entries.title: Lighthouse internal rate arithmetic overflow DoS
entries.impact: Rate-limit arithmetic could overflow and enable remote denial of service conditions.
entries.preconditions: Attacker can send requests that exercise rate accounting edge cases.
entries.exploit_shape: Drive request rate or token accounting into arithmetic boundary values.
entries.root_cause: Internal rate arithmetic used values that could overflow before safe clamp or checked math.
entries.fix_shape: Use checked/saturating arithmetic and add boundary tests for rate-limiter state transitions.
transfer_candidates: Add long-running and boundary-clock rate-limiter probes that inspect limiter recovery, not just response status.

entries.title: Teku BlobSidecarsByRange parameter validation DoS
entries.impact: Invalid BlobSidecarsByRange parameters could trigger remote denial of service behavior.
entries.preconditions: Attacker can send BlobSidecarsByRange req/resp requests.
entries.exploit_shape: Use count, start slot, or range parameters outside valid bounds.
entries.root_cause: The range handler did not reject malformed or out-of-range request parameters early enough.
entries.fix_shape: Validate range parameters before lookup, iteration, allocation, and response scheduling.
transfer_candidates: Mirror the same validation matrix onto DataColumnSidecarsByRange and future Gloas range protocols.

entries.title: Consensus P2P rate limiting under-specification
entries.impact: Underdefined rate-limit behavior can cause cross-client differences in disconnects, errors, and peer scoring.
entries.preconditions: Clients implement different local rate-limit policies for the same P2P protocol.
entries.exploit_shape: Trigger rate-limit boundaries and compare whether clients withhold, close, error, or penalize peers.
entries.root_cause: The P2P spec leaves too much behavior to implementation choice at rate-limit boundaries.
entries.fix_shape: Specify response and scoring behavior for rate-limited responders and add conformance vectors.
transfer_candidates: Extend rate-limit conformance checks to all new req/resp methods and record peer-score consequences.

entries.title: Lodestar memory leak causes P2P crash
entries.impact: A P2P-triggered memory leak could crash Lodestar.
entries.preconditions: Attacker can interact with the affected Lodestar P2P path.
entries.exploit_shape: Repeat the triggering P2P interaction until retained memory grows without release.
entries.root_cause: The public disclosure identifies a P2P memory leak; exact retained object path is not in the disclosure table.
entries.fix_shape: Add leak regression tests around the affected path and assert bounded memory under repeated inputs.
transfer_candidates: Add long-horizon repeated-message tests with memory sampling for Lodestar and cross-client comparison.

entries.title: Prysm go-multiaddr nil-pointer crash via Identify message
entries.impact: A malicious Identify message could crash Prysm through a go-multiaddr nil-pointer dereference.
entries.preconditions: Attacker can complete enough libp2p negotiation to send Identify data.
entries.exploit_shape: Send Identify payloads containing malformed multiaddrs that trigger nil handling in go-multiaddr.
entries.root_cause: Malformed identify/multiaddr data reached a nil-pointer dereference instead of a contained decode error.
entries.fix_shape: Validate Identify multiaddrs before use and update dependency code with nil-safe parsing.
transfer_candidates: Keep Identify message fuzzing with malformed multiaddr fields for all CL clients.

entries.title: Lighthouse yamux pending-frame memory exhaustion
entries.impact: A malicious peer could exhaust Lighthouse memory through an unbounded yamux pending-frame queue.
entries.preconditions: Attacker can establish a yamux transport connection to the target.
entries.exploit_shape: Send frame patterns that accumulate in the multiplexer pending queue faster than they are drained.
entries.root_cause: Yamux pending frames were queued without a strict byte or frame-count limit.
entries.fix_shape: Bound multiplexer pending queues and close peers that exceed frame or memory budgets.
transfer_candidates: Add raw yamux frame-queue pressure tests that do not rely on valid req/resp streams.

entries.title: Prysm mplex goroutine spawning memory exhaustion
entries.impact: A malicious peer could drive goroutine and memory exhaustion through mplex stream behavior.
entries.preconditions: Attacker can negotiate mplex with the target.
entries.exploit_shape: Create stream/frame patterns that spawn goroutines faster than they can complete.
entries.root_cause: Mplex stream handling lacked a strict bound on spawned goroutines or active stream work.
entries.fix_shape: Limit concurrent mplex work per peer and disable or harden vulnerable multiplexer behavior.
transfer_candidates: Add multiplexer-specific goroutine-count checks under repeated stream-open/close patterns.

entries.title: Prysm libp2p protocol book unbounded memory via Identify Push
entries.impact: Identify Push data could grow libp2p protocol-book memory without bound.
entries.preconditions: Attacker can connect and send Identify Push messages.
entries.exploit_shape: Send many or oversized protocol identifiers through Identify Push to retain protocol-book entries.
entries.root_cause: Protocol-book state accepted peer-controlled Identify Push data without sufficient cardinality or size bounds.
entries.fix_shape: Bound stored protocol IDs per peer, reject oversized Identify Push messages, and expire stale entries.
transfer_candidates: Keep Identify Push protocol-list cardinality and byte-size tests in heavy mode.

entries.title: Prysm gossipsub malformed topic hex decoding panic
entries.impact: A malformed gossipsub topic could panic Prysm during topic hex decoding.
entries.preconditions: Attacker can publish or advertise gossip on malformed topic strings that reach Prysm parsing.
entries.exploit_shape: Use a topic with malformed fork digest or subnet hex text that triggers panic-prone decoding.
entries.root_cause: Topic parsing assumed valid hex/fork-digest structure instead of returning a safe reject result.
entries.fix_shape: Parse topic components with error returns and fuzz malformed topic strings.
transfer_candidates: Add malformed topic-string corpus: short fork digest, non-hex digest, bad subnet suffix, oversized suffix.

entries.title: Nimbus blob sidecar range quota exceeded by Electra limit confusion
entries.impact: Blob sidecar range handling could exceed intended quota by treating an Electra limit as a slot cap.
entries.preconditions: Attacker can send BlobSidecarsByRange requests across fork/limit boundaries.
entries.exploit_shape: Use request ranges that exploit a mismatch between per-fork blob limits and slot-count accounting.
entries.root_cause: Quota accounting mixed fork-specific constants and request dimensions.
entries.fix_shape: Charge quota by actual response work and validate fork-specific limits before serving ranges.
transfer_candidates: Add fork-aware quota tests for blob and data-column range requests that compare requested slots, returned chunks, and charged tokens.

entries.title: IPv6 /64 collocation not aggregated enables validator eclipse
entries.impact: Attackers using many IPv6 addresses in one /64 could bypass collocation scoring and improve eclipse chances.
entries.preconditions: Attacker controls many IPv6 addresses in the same /64 and can create many peer identities.
entries.exploit_shape: Connect Sybil peers from many addresses under one /64 so per-IP scoring treats them as distinct.
entries.root_cause: Collocation accounting did not aggregate IPv6 peers at the /64 boundary.
entries.fix_shape: Score and limit IPv6 peers by stable subnet grouping, not only full address identity.
transfer_candidates: Extend configurable source-address/Sybil admission tests with real IPv6 /64 proxy control.

entries.title: SSZ-snappy req/resp trailing bytes accepted by multiple clients
entries.impact: Malformed requests with valid SSZ-snappy prefixes and trailing bytes can be processed inconsistently across clients.
entries.preconditions: Attacker can open req/resp streams and append bytes after a valid length-delimited payload.
entries.exploit_shape: Send valid Ping, MetaData, Goodbye, or block request payloads followed by extra bytes or snappy chunks.
entries.root_cause: Several decoders read exactly the declared payload length and fail to verify EOF after the framed payload.
entries.fix_shape: After successful decode, verify stream EOF and return INVALID_REQUEST for trailing data.
transfer_candidates: Apply trailing-byte EOF checks to every new req/resp protocol, including Gloas payload envelopes.

entries.title: Prysm Ping can spawn unbounded metadata request goroutines
entries.impact: High-sequence Ping requests can amplify into target-initiated MetaData streams and goroutines.
entries.preconditions: Attacker can connect one or more peer identities and complete enough req/resp handshake for Ping.
entries.exploit_shape: Send Ping requests with increasing metadata sequence numbers while delaying or multiplying metadata responses.
entries.root_cause: Prysm starts a background metadata fetch goroutine per qualifying Ping without a per-peer in-flight guard.
entries.fix_shape: Track per-peer metadata fetches, add a global semaphore, and derive goroutine context from service/request lifetime.
transfer_candidates: Promote the PoC into a differential test that counts target-initiated MetaData streams per Ping burst.

entries.title: Lighthouse next fork digest divergence is already known
entries.impact: Incorrect ENR next-fork-digest advertisement can confuse fork-boundary peer discovery and should not be refiled as new.
entries.preconditions: Network is near or past a configured fork transition.
entries.exploit_shape: Observe ENR/metadata fork digest fields across fork transition and compare against expected zero/next digest.
entries.root_cause: Local analysis found Lighthouse kept a stale nonzero next fork digest after transition.
entries.fix_shape: Recompute and clear next fork digest at fork boundary according to fork schedule state.
transfer_candidates: Keep the allowlist entry linked to this report; use disappearance as possible regression/fix evidence.

entries.title: Nimbus custody group count divergence is already known
entries.impact: Custody group count metadata/ENR divergence affects data-column availability interpretation and should not be filed again without new impact.
entries.preconditions: Fulu data-column custody metadata is advertised and queried.
entries.exploit_shape: Compare ENR and MetaData custody group count values against expected supernode behavior.
entries.root_cause: Local analysis tracks Nimbus advertising a non-128 custody count in supernode-oriented testnets; the original report observed cgc=4 and the current allowlist records cgc=64.
entries.fix_shape: Align custody metadata with configured custody behavior or document intentional non-supernode behavior.
transfer_candidates: When cgc behavior changes, rerun data-column range/root tests before promoting any new Nimbus availability finding; treat stale allowlist values as possible fix evidence.

entries.title: Geth p2p Ping handler unbounded goroutine DoS
entries.impact: Flooding p2p Ping requests could spawn unbounded goroutines and exhaust memory.
entries.preconditions: Attacker can connect as an EL p2p peer.
entries.exploit_shape: Send a high volume of Ping requests that each spawn response work.
entries.root_cause: The p2p handler created a goroutine per Ping response without bounding concurrent work.
entries.fix_shape: Respond synchronously or bound ping response work with worker limits/backpressure.
transfer_candidates: Mirror as CL Ping/MetaData amplification tests; compare to LOCAL-PRYSM-PING-METADATA-2026.

entries.title: Geth GetBlockHeaders count=0 underflow bypasses maxHeadersServe
entries.impact: A count of zero underflowed to UINT64_MAX and could request all headers back to genesis.
entries.preconditions: Attacker can send ETH protocol GetBlockHeadersRequest messages.
entries.exploit_shape: Send GetBlockHeadersRequest with count=0 to bypass maximum header serving limits.
entries.root_cause: The handler computed count-1 before rejecting zero, passing UINT64_MAX into range retrieval.
entries.fix_shape: Reject zero counts before arithmetic and keep max-serve checks on the original request dimensions.
transfer_candidates: Keep count_zero and both_max tests for every CL range protocol before any start+count arithmetic.

entries.title: Geth snap/1 malformed GetTrieNodes crash
entries.impact: A malicious snap/1 GetTrieNodes request could crash the node with a panic.
entries.preconditions: Attacker is connected on the snap/1 protocol.
entries.exploit_shape: Request trie paths that make internal lookup return nil where non-nil was assumed.
entries.root_cause: Malformed or absent trie nodes were not checked for nil before method calls.
entries.fix_shape: Treat missing trie nodes as safe empty results/errors and fuzz malformed request bodies.
transfer_candidates: Model as CL malformed request paths that reach lookup nil/empty data states after successful decode.

entries.title: Geth invalid secp256k1 peer handshake key crash
entries.impact: An all-zero or invalid EC public key during RLPx handshake could crash the node.
entries.preconditions: Attacker can initiate the p2p connection handshake.
entries.exploit_shape: Send invalid secp256k1 public keys during shared-secret computation.
entries.root_cause: The handshake did not validate that the remote EC public key was a valid curve point before use.
entries.fix_shape: Check peer public keys for curve validity before shared-secret computation.
transfer_candidates: Add CL Noise/static-key negative tests where libraries permit malformed key injection.

entries.title: Erigon: remote Denial of Service via req/resp query
entries.impact: Contest-submitted Low report retained as an unverified P2P security hypothesis; if reproduced, it may expose availability, peer-selection, propagation, or quota risk.
entries.preconditions: A hostile peer, proposer, execution peer, or local devnet test harness can exercise the relevant P2P path; independent reproduction is required before filing.
entries.exploit_shape: Use the candidate test shape: Range request tests should include start=0, count=max, start near head, and count crossing retention windows.
entries.root_cause: DataColumnSidecarsByRange handlers must reject extreme start/count combinations before slot iteration; response limits alone do not bound server-side scan work.
entries.fix_shape: Validate peer-controlled counts, indices, and ranges before iteration, allocation, or bit math.
transfer_candidates: Range request tests should include start=0, count=max, start near head, and count crossing retention windows.

entries.title: Prysm has abnormal behaviour from LH, TEKU and Specs on BPO + HardFork epoch, which leads to a network peer isolation of all Prysm nodes
entries.impact: Contest-submitted Medium report retained as an unverified P2P security hypothesis; if reproduced, it may expose availability, peer-selection, propagation, or quota risk.
entries.preconditions: A hostile peer, proposer, execution peer, or local devnet test harness can exercise the relevant P2P path; independent reproduction is required before filing.
entries.exploit_shape: Use the candidate test shape: Generate forktransition profiles where BPO and CL fork epochs are equal, adjacent, and absent.
entries.root_cause: BPO changes that coincide with hard forks can create fork-digest and ENR next-fork-digest ordering ambiguity.
entries.fix_shape: Align implementation behavior with the source spec and add cross-client differential tests for the ambiguous boundary.
transfer_candidates: Generate forktransition profiles where BPO and CL fork epochs are equal, adjacent, and absent.

entries.title: Nimbus: remote DoS via large custody group count metadata update
entries.impact: Contest-submitted Medium report retained as an unverified P2P security hypothesis; if reproduced, it may expose availability, peer-selection, propagation, or quota risk.
entries.preconditions: A hostile peer, proposer, execution peer, or local devnet test harness can exercise the relevant P2P path; independent reproduction is required before filing.
entries.exploit_shape: Use the candidate test shape: Inject metadata/ENR cgc values 0, 1, 4, 8, 128, 129, and max_uint64 before data-column requests.
entries.root_cause: Peer metadata updates that change custody_group_count must be clamped before computing custody groups or looping over derived columns.
entries.fix_shape: Validate peer-controlled counts, indices, and ranges before iteration, allocation, or bit math.
transfer_candidates: Inject metadata/ENR cgc values 0, 1, 4, 8, 128, 129, and max_uint64 before data-column requests.

entries.title: [Lodestar][EIP-7594] Inbound rate-limiter undercounts `DataColumnByRange` and `DataColumnByRoot` requests
entries.impact: Contest-submitted Low report retained as an unverified P2P security hypothesis; if reproduced, it may expose availability, peer-selection, propagation, or quota risk.
entries.preconditions: A hostile peer, proposer, execution peer, or local devnet test harness can exercise the relevant P2P path; independent reproduction is required before filing.
entries.exploit_shape: Use the candidate test shape: Add quota tests with one slot and 1, 64, 128 columns; compare bytes/chunks served against tokens charged.
entries.root_cause: DataColumn ByRange/ByRoot rate accounting must charge by slot/root times requested columns, not only by slot/root count.
entries.fix_shape: Charge quota by the actual protocol work unit and include fork-specific response dimensions.
transfer_candidates: Add quota tests with one slot and 1, 64, 128 columns; compare bytes/chunks served against tokens charged.

entries.title: Malicious gossip peer will stall PeerDAS sampling for custody validators
entries.impact: Contest-submitted High report retained as an unverified P2P security hypothesis; if reproduced, it may expose availability, peer-selection, propagation, or quota risk.
entries.preconditions: A hostile peer, proposer, execution peer, or local devnet test harness can exercise the relevant P2P path; independent reproduction is required before filing.
entries.exploit_shape: Use the candidate test shape: Replay invalid then valid sidecar for the same tuple and verify the valid message is not suppressed.
entries.root_cause: Seen caches for data_column_sidecar gossip should mark messages after validation or distinguish invalid from valid retries.
entries.fix_shape: Deduplicate only after the correct validation point and suppress repeated expensive work.
transfer_candidates: Replay invalid then valid sidecar for the same tuple and verify the valid message is not suppressed.

entries.title: ENR custody group count spoofing drives sampling failure and selective eclipse
entries.impact: Contest-submitted Info report retained as an unverified P2P security hypothesis; if reproduced, it may expose availability, peer-selection, propagation, or quota risk.
entries.preconditions: A hostile peer, proposer, execution peer, or local devnet test harness can exercise the relevant P2P path; independent reproduction is required before filing.
entries.exploit_shape: Use the candidate test shape: Compare ENR cgc, MetaData cgc, served-column behavior, and peer-selection priority for Sybil peers.
entries.root_cause: ENR custody_group_count over-claims can bias PeerDAS peer selection if not cross-checked against metadata and observed service.
entries.fix_shape: Cross-check discovery claims against observed service and bound discovery-triggered work.

entries.title: Goroutine Fan-out under Burst Load in P2P Broadcaster enables Local DoS
entries.impact: Contest-submitted Medium report retained as an unverified P2P security hypothesis; if reproduced, it may expose availability, peer-selection, propagation, or quota risk.
entries.preconditions: A hostile peer, proposer, execution peer, or local devnet test harness can exercise the relevant P2P path; independent reproduction is required before filing.
entries.exploit_shape: Use the candidate test shape: Add broadcaster burst tests that count goroutines/tasks under gossip publish failures and peer flaps.
entries.root_cause: Broadcast paths that spawn one goroutine per PublishToTopic call need worker limits and short cancellation contexts.
entries.fix_shape: Apply per-peer and global in-flight limits, dedupe repeated work, and enforce backoff.
transfer_candidates: Extend broadcaster burst tests with longer peer-flap runs and client-specific task metrics.

entries.impact: Contest-submitted Medium report retained as an unverified P2P security hypothesis; if reproduced, it may expose availability, peer-selection, propagation, or quota risk.
entries.preconditions: A hostile peer, proposer, execution peer, or local devnet test harness can exercise the relevant P2P path; independent reproduction is required before filing.
entries.exploit_shape: Use the candidate test shape: Inject stale attestation/sync messages over many subnets and count dials before rejection.
entries.root_cause: Freshness checks should run before peer discovery/dial attempts so stale gossip cannot amplify outbound dials.
entries.fix_shape: Charge quota by the actual protocol work unit and include fork-specific response dimensions.

entries.title: An attacker can censor broadcasts by ensuring node has exactly one peer on a subnet
entries.impact: Contest-submitted High report retained as an unverified P2P security hypothesis; if reproduced, it may expose availability, peer-selection, propagation, or quota risk.

entries.exploit_shape: Use the candidate test shape: Test subnet broadcast behavior with 0, 1, and N peers and verify fallback discovery/flood behavior.
